bullets.id: Data tenaga kerja AS jauh lebih kuat dari perkiraan: payroll Oktober bertambah 165.000, hampir tiga kali perkiraan 65.000, pengangguran turun ke 4,1% dan upah per jam naik 0,4%. Revisi dua bulan sebelumnya menambah 84.000. Emas spot turun 0,6% ke $4.065 pada penutupan Jumat, tetapi tetap naik 4,9% dalam sepekan.
bullets.en: US jobs data came in far stronger than expected: October payrolls rose 165,000, nearly three times the 65,000 forecast, unemployment fell to 4.1% and hourly earnings rose 0.4%. Revisions to the prior two months added 84,000. Spot gold fell 0.6% to $4,065 at Friday’s close but still gained 4.9% on the week.

bullets.id: Peluang kenaikan bunga Fed 25 bp pada 9 Desember naik ke hampir 79% dari sekitar 73%. Yield 2 tahun naik sekitar 6 bp ke 4,53%, yield 10 tahun di sekitar 4,86%, dan indeks dolar naik 0,74% ke 102,18. Brent di sekitar $97,75. Emas masih sekitar 27,5% di bawah rekor $5.608,35 dan turun 0,99% dalam sebulan.
bullets.en: Odds of a 25 bp Fed hike on 9 December rose to nearly 79% from about 73%. The 2-year yield rose about 6 bp to 4.53%, the 10-year sits near 4.86%, and the dollar index rose 0.74% to 102.18. Brent is near $97.75. Gold is still about 27.5% below its $5,608.35 record and down 0.99% over the month.

bullets.id: Kitco menyebut resistance di $4.051 lalu $4.089, support di $4.022, dan target bearish di $3.992. Pekan depan, pasar menunggu CPI Oktober pada Selasa 10 November dan PPI pada Jumat 13 November; inflasi yang panas bisa mengukuhkan taruhan kenaikan bunga Desember.
bullets.en: Kitco puts resistance at $4,051 then $4,089, support at $4,022, and a bearish target at $3,992. Next week markets await October CPI on Tuesday 10 November and PPI on Friday 13 November; hot inflation could cement December hike bets.

bullets.id: Antam 1 gram turun Rp20.000 ke Rp2.545.000 dan buyback turun Rp20.000 ke Rp2.350.000, sehingga spread tetap Rp195.000 (sekitar 7,7%). Galeri24 turun Rp11.000 ke Rp2.507.000 (buyback Rp2.360.000) dan UBS turun Rp25.000 ke Rp2.540.000 (buyback Rp2.334.000). Secara struktural, bank sentral membeli 321 ton pada kuartal III dan kepemilikan ETF mencapai rekor 4.256 ton.
bullets.en: Antam’s 1-gram price fell Rp20,000 to Rp2,545,000 and buyback fell Rp20,000 to Rp2,350,000, leaving the spread at Rp195,000 (about 7.7%). Galeri24 fell Rp11,000 to Rp2,507,000 (buyback Rp2,360,000) and UBS fell Rp25,000 to Rp2,540,000 (buyback Rp2,334,000). Structurally, central banks bought 321 tonnes in Q3 and ETF holdings hit a record 4,256 tonnes.
